subject.title: Feature: config option to route gateway lifecycle warnings to a dedicated channel

question: Should OpenClaw add a general messages-level internal-warning destination/category router, and what categories/defaults should it support relative to existing suppression and cron-specific controls?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear in source, but choosing a public config contract and diagnostic visibility semantics is a maintainer product decision.

options.title: Approve default-compatible router
options.body: Add an explicit opt-in router for lifecycle, tool-error, and system-notice warnings while preserving current active-channel behavior by default.

options.title: Keep suppression-only controls
options.body: Treat messages.suppressToolErrors and narrower channel fixes as the supported operator path and close or narrow routing requests after maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Split warning classes
options.body: Handle lifecycle, tool errors, cron, and session maintenance warnings as separate issues instead of one shared router.

recommendation.title: Approve default-compatible router
recommendation.body: Add an explicit opt-in router for lifecycle, tool-error, and system-notice warnings while preserving current active-channel behavior by default.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history on warning-policy behavior and prior follow-up notes for the broader policy surface.
